title: Microcode — 8-Bit CPU Workbench
description: Write assembly, watch a 1024-byte CPU execute it instruction by instruction, and draw to a memory-mapped screen.
concept: A complete little computer in one HTML file: a two-pass assembler with labels, directives and real error reporting, a 40-opcode 8-bit CPU, and a 16x16 memory-mapped display at $200. Write code in the highlighted editor, assemble it live, then run it at anything from 60 instructions a second to 60 million — or single-step and watch the datapath buses light up as PC, RAM, IR and ALU hand bytes to each other. Six worked example programs ship with it, from a hex Fibonacci printer to an XOR plasma demo. Export the source, the assembled machine code, a hex listing or a PNG of the screen.
features: Two-pass assembler: labels, forward references, .byte/.ascii/.word/.org/.fill, per-line error messages you can click to jump to
40-opcode 8-bit ISA with immediate, absolute and X/Y-indexed addressing, a hardware stack, JSR/RTS and Z/C/N flags
Run, stop, single-step and reset, with an 8-position clock from 60 to 60M instructions per second
Live machine inspector: registers, flags, animated datapath, full 1024-byte hex memory view with PC/write/stack highlighting
16x16 memory-mapped display at $200 plus character-out, RNG and frame-tick ports
Six example programs — banner, Fibonacci, prime sieve, XOR plasma, bouncing dot, spark rain
Export source .asm, assembled .bin, a hex listing, or the screen as PNG
Named projects and an autosaved draft in localStorage, plus shareable #p= permalinks

interaction.mouse: Drag the CLK slider to set clock speed; click an error row to jump to that line; click the memory jump buttons to scan code, stack, VRAM or ports.
interaction.click: Run/Stop, Step and Reset drive the CPU; Examples loads a program; Projects saves and reloads named sources; Export writes .asm, .bin, a hex listing, a screen PNG or a share link.
interaction.touch: Code/Machine tabs swap between the editor and the machine panes; every control is tap-sized and both columns scroll.
interaction.keyboard: Ctrl/Cmd+Enter runs or stops, F8 single-steps, Esc stops, Tab indents in the editor.
